name: openqodex
description: Code review before you push, inside Claude Code. Runs the scanners that fit your change (Semgrep, Gitleaks, OSV-Scanner, ShellCheck, Ruff and more) on the lines you changed for security vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets, vulnerable dependencies and lint errors. Claude then reviews the change on its own model, and a final step with no model checks each finding's format, whether it sits on a changed line, and any scanner it cites. Use after writing or changing code and before git push. Free and open source, no API key, no account.
